relations.description: UE behavior depends on whether it is a L2 U2N Remote UE.
SpCellConfig may contain RLF timers and constants configuration.
UE timer configuration depends on DAPS bearer configuration.
SpCellConfig may contain dedicated SpCell configuration.
When reference signals for radio link monitoring are reconfigured, timer T310 is stopped.
When reference signals for radio link monitoring are reconfigured, timer T312 is stopped.
When reference signals for radio link monitoring are reconfigured, counter N310 is reset.
When reference signals for radio link monitoring are reconfigured, counter N311 is reset.
